strings.zh: 喂喂,{NEWLINE}你有什么事么？{SCROLL}现在的小孩子,就算再近{NEWLINE}也只肯用电话联系。{SCROLL}我想跟他们{CLEAR}面对面聊天啊。
strings.en: Hello?{NEWLINE}Oh, hello. How are you?{SCROLL}Kids nowadays can just call even though{NEWLINE}they’re nearby...{SCROLL}I’d rather talk face-to-face...

strings.zh: 你寄放在我这的精灵{NEWLINE}下蛋了,{SCROLL}想看看是什么样的蛋吗？{NEWLINE}那就快来我这儿拿吧。
